name: Polymega Collection Vol. 14: Astyanax
summary:
Travel through ancient battlefields and explore genre-bending game worlds with this special Jaleco & Psikyo collection for Polymega. The centerpiece is Astyanax, also known as LORD OF KING -- available in both its arcade and NES versions, giving players two distinct takes on the same mythic adventure! From there, the collection branches into some of Jaleco’s most interesting and varied titles: raise and duel dragons in the PS1 monster-breeding RPG Dragon Seeds, duel with enormous bosses in the side-scrolling action game Totally Rad (aka Magic John), and cut through hordes of enemies in the dark fantasy brawling shooter Sol Divide. You’ll also find the genre-bending Pinball Quest, which fuses RPG mechanics with classic pinball tables, and Takeda Shingen (Shingen Samurai Fighter), a side-scrolling brawler set in Japan’s feudal era.

With genre-bending classics and genre staples in one set, this Polymega Collection DVD highlights Jaleco’s adventurous side and offers a range of experiences you won’t find collected anywhere else!
